items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Edward Yeah that's Edward's daddy Hoes

ctx.x: Is he related to Harold Dejon Do you know?

I don't know Well I'll tell you how I met him Victor had a high award in my country See Racin Yeah And we moved from Racin to Reserv Yeah That's way back That's way back Way back Yeah Well then I met Dejon I was a young kid Just learning Yeah And they had a dance one night And I went to float a little bit And he liked it when I played But we didn't stay up But maybe Six months Something like that Till the water dried up Then we went on back That's how I met Dejon Now we just finished getting all the names We got…
Well including yourself That would make five
